video_title: Boogie - Thunder Won't Win A Game vs Wemby, Spurs?!?

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams praises Alex Caruso's Game 1 offensive and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Just him coming in, understanding that Wemby is guarding him now and he's going to have some space.
quotes.quote: Just him coming in, understanding that Wemby is guarding him now and he's going to have some space because they're trying to create, they're not trying to allow SGA lanes to get into the hole and Wemby's playing free safety there and understanding the ability to be able to shoot the ball. I thought he played great on the defensive end. He tried his best to make it difficult for Wemby to catch the ball, was able to get a couple of steals out of those posts.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Chet Holmgren needing to be more involved in games
quotes.excerpt: They got to find a way to get Chet involved in this thing and Chet got to find a way to get involved.
quotes.quote: He played a great game, but they got to find a way to get Chet involved in this thing and Chet got to find a way to get involved, whether it's going to be on the offensive end or the defensive end. Going into the second half and only having one shot attempt at halftime, you just can't have that for one of your All-Star caliber players.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins critiques Chet Holmgren's defensive effort against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: It looked like he tucked his tail, bro. It really did.
quotes.quote: It's hard to, obviously with Chet, he's not in the same position as a Wemby who's going to get as many touches, as many shot attempts. But like you said, defensively, with the ability that he does have, he needs to have a bigger impact on the game and I think he has to accept that challenge. Yes, I think Alex Caruso is a good matchup in certain situations, especially when he's out extended on the perimeter. Yes, I want Caruso with that matchup. But anything from the free throw line in, that's automatically a Chet or Hartenstein matchup. So, I said earlier, that's something that I would like to see next game where he steps up more to the challenge. But it looked like he tucked his tail, bro. It really did.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams explains Spurs' defensive strategy against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: San Antonio did a great job of just putting him in a position that everything that he was going to get, he was going to work for.
quotes.quote: Defensively, yes. He saw a lot of bodies him trying to drive. He likes to play in that mid-range, likes to get to the rim, likes to play fouls. They just decided that they weren't going to, they were going to make him play from the three-point line and beyond and make it difficult for him. And even on the ones that it looked like he was going to be comfortable, they ran and junked up the game and they were trapping him up the court, taking the ball out of his hands and making somebody else do it. I think San Antonio did a great job of just putting him in a position that everything that he was going to get, he was going to work for and he couldn't really get into this game until the second half because of the way that the San Antonio Spurs were guarding him.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins believes Spurs' lengthy defenders match up well with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: This Spurs team, they match up well. They got long lengthy defenders.
quotes.quote: I think he'll have a better performance moving forward. I think Game 1, the Spurs did an incredible job of having multiple bodies meeting him at his spots, which was boxes and elbows. So credit to them for that, but I do believe he'll have a better performance. But this Spurs team, they match up well. They got long lengthy defenders. He's usually one of the bigger guards on the floor. They kind of have that size to match up with that, probably I would say through the one through three spots. You got the young kid Castle who's a bully on the defensive end as far as how he matches up with guards. So it is a great matchup overall, but I think he'll figure it out and adjust.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle, Lou Williams, and DeMarcus Cousins predict Spurs-Thunder series outcome
quotes.excerpt: If last night is what I'm looking forward to for the rest of this series, I don't think anybody gets out clean.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Yesterday Chandler had OKC in five. Lou, you had OKC in six. Boogie, you're here now and you said something in the room and I swear...

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Seven game series. No, I'm changing my position as well.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: What I said in the room was if we get this type of performance from Wemby every night and Chet doesn't meet that matchup, I absolutely do believe they won't win a game.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Is that not crazy? That was said out loud and I loved it so much.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I ain't subscribing to that page. I ain't following that page.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: But that's a big but. But what I'm trying to say is at that level, I absolutely see it happening.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Seven game series. I'm going to have to lean with the champs. I got to lean with the champs.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Spurs. It's fair. You guys can keep.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I think it, I think this goes seven now. If last night is what I'm looking forward to for the rest of this series, I don't think anybody gets out clean. I think this goes the distance.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: I think it's Spurs in six.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I got to respect it. Coming from where you come from, I wouldn't expect you to say. You're giving it six games is respect, so I'll take that.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: That is very much respect on my part.
